_comment: Coral projection player — copy to coral-projection.json and edit. Mirrors config.yaml's role for the server: every port, path and timing lives here, never in code.
_video_dir_note: Absolute path to the folder holding the exported clips. Leave "" to resolve clips relative to this config file's own directory.
_clips_note: Three loops plus one one-shot. healthy/fluorescent/bleached loop forever and their lengths do not affect behaviour (60s recommended). latch plays once on the 1->2 bleach latch and is 20s. Its bound is crossfade_s < length < recovery_lag_s (1.5s < 20s < 30s): state 2 cannot be shorter than recovery_lag_s, so a clip under that can never be cut short mid-telling. WITH A 20s CLIP THE MARGIN IS 10s — do not lower recovery_lag_s below ~25s without shortening this clip. There are no directional transition clips; every other change is an opacity blend driven by intensity.
_crossfade_note: One fade rate for everything. Also acts as the slew limit on the state 0/1 intensity blend, and as the lead-in used to hand a one-shot over before its last frame (so the clip never freezes while fading).
_video_size_note: Native frame size of the exported clips — same as the canvas, so every source pixel maps to one projector pixel. Stated, not detected: the RenderTextures are built before any clip is prepared, and a RenderTexture whose aspect disagrees with the video squashes the frame before the compositor sees it. The player logs a warning at startup if a prepared clip disagrees with these numbers.
_display_note: Spanned canvas across both Epson EB-435W (1280x800 each). macOS Displays must be set to Extend, arranged side by side — that is an OS setting, not something this player controls.
_fit_note: With source and canvas both 2560x800 this is a no-op (scale 1,1 offset 0,0) and pan is irrelevant. It stays as a safety net: if a clip is ever exported at the wrong size, 'cover' crops to fill without distorting rather than silently squashing. Watch for the startup warning instead of relying on it.
